advertisedDesignCapabilities.purpose: Install the selected layout rather than recolor Core
advertisedDesignCapabilities.currentSupport: Canonical Liquid/catalog/install/draft/release primitives exist; MadeYours is design only
advertisedDesignCapabilities.missingContract: Versioned nova artifact, bounded configurator layout settings and catalog preview fixture
advertisedDesignCapabilities.emptyError: Empty real catalog stays empty; failed apply preserves document
advertisedDesignCapabilities.security: Schema settings; Liquid escaping, ownPropertyOnly and render limits
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dependency: Coordinator owns shared catalog/document/export changes in Milestone 2
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: Install → edit/save/readback → preview → explicit publish → anonymous release output retains this structure

advertisedDesignCapabilities.missingContract: Bind actual merchant products and safe niche facts
advertisedDesignCapabilities.emptyError: Missing image placeholder, missing critical constraints explicit, unavailable choice retained and disabled
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: Selected Walnut SKU and price agree with server; Oak unavailable cannot submit

advertisedDesignCapabilities.currentSupport: Basic search/navigation exists; complete niche method facets not established
advertisedDesignCapabilities.missingContract: Allowlisted method/type facets, sort, count and URLs from actual query
advertisedDesignCapabilities.emptyError: Keep query/filters; clear one/all; distinguish failed from empty
advertisedDesignCapabilities.security: Tenant scope; bounded query and page limits
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dependency: One shared query extension owner, not reserved search-service
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: Facet composition, clear-one, back navigation and pagination return real same-site results

advertisedDesignCapabilities.owner: commerce-core + shared-types + existing product editor + storefront Liquid/island adapter
advertisedDesignCapabilities.currentSupport: Generic metadata/properties are not sufficient end-to-end support
advertisedDesignCapabilities.missingContract: Versioned allowed methods/styles/placement, NFC/grapheme normalization, limits, safe allowlist and price consequences; approved merchant method/policy
advertisedDesignCapabilities.emptyError: Retain invalid draft and last valid snapshot; precise field error; no silent character replacement
advertisedDesignCapabilities.security: Escape all output, reject extra fields/markup/control characters; size/rate limits
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dependency: Central contract/schema owner; no upload/proof service
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: Disallowed symbol, long text, leading/trailing whitespace, combining forms, script rejection/support, malicious markup and price revalidation verified at server

advertisedDesignCapabilities.purpose: Understand text and placement without promising exact visual fidelity
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dataSource: Validated draft/configuration response plus original base media
advertisedDesignCapabilities.missingContract: Preview consumes permitted product-defined geometry; accepted written summary is confirmed deliberately
advertisedDesignCapabilities.emptyError: Invalid draft retains old preview with clear last-valid label; missing critical schema prevents configuration
advertisedDesignCapabilities.security: Native escaped text only, no executable merchant input
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: Preview label visible; exact normalized text, case, method, style, placement and price match accepted response

advertisedDesignCapabilities.feature: Distinct configured cart lines and edit/retry
advertisedDesignCapabilities.purpose: Keep two names on one SKU separate
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dataSource: Server cart line input/output and canonical configuration fingerprint
advertisedDesignCapabilities.owner: checkout-core + gateway cart + current cart island
advertisedDesignCapabilities.currentSupport: Properties accepted/preserved in cart; no proof of full configuration identity/order behavior
advertisedDesignCapabilities.missingContract: Server configuration hash/version into identity; idempotent add/edit; stale schema/price revalidation
advertisedDesignCapabilities.emptyError: Failed edit preserves accepted line and unsaved text; resolve/cancel before checkout; stock/price changes explained
advertisedDesignCapabilities.security: Fingerprint produced by server; replay scoped to buyer/cart/site and intent
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dependency: Shared cart contract and mutation owner
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: Asha and Kabir remain two lines; same-intent retry one effect; edit/reprice and stock race retain correct configuration

advertisedDesignCapabilities.purpose: Commit the exact reviewed configuration once
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dataSource: Canonical quote, cart-bound handoff, checkout session and order_items
advertisedDesignCapabilities.owner: checkout-core + gateway checkout/order RPC + apps/commerce/web checkout origin
advertisedDesignCapabilities.currentSupport: Shared checkout and order primitives; personalized snapshot binding not proven
advertisedDesignCapabilities.missingContract: Cart fingerprint/configuration version in handoff, immutable per-item order copy, original-intent reconciliation
advertisedDesignCapabilities.emptyError: Unknown payment result checks original attempt before new commitment; expired handoff requotes/reviews
advertisedDesignCapabilities.security: Server pricing, tenant scope, signed handoff, provider proof, idempotency and atomic order write
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dependency: Money/order full relevant test classes under named owner
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: Fault/lost response + concurrent retry yields one order effect and exact accepted item snapshot, buyer and merchant readback agree

advertisedDesignCapabilities.owner: Existing merchant order/fulfillment presentation + gateway order owner
advertisedDesignCapabilities.currentSupport: Not verified for this new contract
advertisedDesignCapabilities.missingContract: Permissioned merchant readback for exact text/style/method/placement and immutable schema version; production/change policy
advertisedDesignCapabilities.emptyError: Missing snapshot is a fulfillment blocker; never fall back to a mutable product text field
advertisedDesignCapabilities.security: Site/role enforcement, escape customer text, minimal retained fields
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dependency: Shared order contract owner + merchant presentation owner; policy decision if required
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: Merchant sees exact Asha/Kabir snapshots; wrong tenant denied; mutable product changes cannot rewrite order

advertisedDesignCapabilities.feature: Buyer identity, profile, addresses and orders
advertisedDesignCapabilities.purpose: Use canonical buyer account with MadeYours destination
advertisedDesignCapabilities.currentSupport: Current BuyerAuthorize email/password and min8 registration, identity session then explicit Continue source inspected. Threadline existing login/profile/address evidence is separate from unverified MadeYours integration.
advertisedDesignCapabilities.missingContract: Bind named storefront destination and explicit signed-in Continue/email disclosure; populated configured-order readback. Optional email verification is separate, not an automatic post-registration step.
advertisedDesignCapabilities.emptyError: Expiry reauth preserves safe return; field validation preserves edits; foreign/missing order denied without disclosure
advertisedDesignCapabilities.security: One issuer, safe registered return, buyer ownership, store resolved server-side
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dependency: Reuse shared identity fixes; no theme auth issuer
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: Real browser signup/sign-in with configured bot check, explicit Continue/registered redirect; optional email verification only through supported separate UI; profile/address reload; direct owned order URL and cross-buyer/store denial.

advertisedDesignCapabilities.currentSupport: Policy text and shipping primitives; no trustworthy production ETA established
advertisedDesignCapabilities.missingContract: Merchant production/edit/returns terms and evidence-backed estimates
advertisedDesignCapabilities.emptyError: Estimate unavailable; no guaranteed cancellation or arrival date
advertisedDesignCapabilities.security: Sanitized content and server rate validation
advertisedDesignCapabilities.dependency: Business policy only where actual approval is missing
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: No invented delivery promise; actual unavailable quote and change restriction explained

advertisedDesignCapabilities.feature: Uploads, proof approval, automatic bundle, customer wallet, new renderer
advertisedDesignCapabilities.purpose: Excluded from initial bounded text scope
advertisedDesignCapabilities.security: No private files or customer wallet introduced
advertisedDesignCapabilities.acceptance: Absence does not replace the required text configuration workflow

independentApplicability.appSeamDecision: APP-SEAM-01: Activation CONSTITUTIONALLY_EXCLUDED; required restriction/preservation/no misleading control acceptance stays NOT_RUN. No new human architectural decision needed.
independentApplicability.configuredCartEditDecision: MY-G05-REVIEW: OPEN. Agent remove/re-add amendment cannot remove the approved inline edit promise. No direct human acceptance changing it established here. See CONFIGURED_CART_EDIT_CONTRACT.md.

gapsAndLimitations.description: No current source/native/browser lease; helper resumption pending in execution state.
No admitted Test Mode credential/account/webhook ingress receipt; no credential files inspected.
Header/footer are pinned groups; do not pretend they can be deleted/re-added from template Add section. Test supported group settings/blocks and group persistence.

APP-SEAM-01 independently resolves inherited @app activation as forbidden. Inventory and test dormant restriction/preservation/no misleading active control; no activation or new human architectural decision.

MY-G05-REVIEW keeps the approved inline configured-cart edit promise required. Agent remove/re-add amendment cannot remove it; preserve original line until acknowledged replacement, using existing canonical review/cart flow. See private contract; no implementation claimed.
Declared renderer branch is source presence only. Catalogue/editor/runtime wiring and every public result still require installed tests.
